_doc._about: Pre-registration for the FR-5.2 promotion gate (PRD.md FR-5.2, PRD_STRATEGY_FACTORY.md FR-F3.4, docs/factory/FACTORY_ARCHITECTURE.md section 9 item 8). Copy to configs/factory/gate_registration.json, fill every REPLACE_ME, and COMMIT IT BEFORE THE FIRST PAPER TRADE of the promoted genome. scripts/gate.py reads this file and refuses to pass a run whose registration does not match the promoted spec. The file is timestamp-free on purpose: the commit that adds it is the timestamp (see registered_before_first_trade).
_doc.schema_version: Integer. Bump when the meaning of any field changes; gate.py refuses unknown versions.
_doc.strategy_name: Exact Strategy.name the sandbox writes into the journal's strategy_name ('Genome <id8>'). Only rows with this name are gated.
_doc.promoted_spec_path: Repo-relative path to the promoted spec JSON. gate.py loads it through src.factory.promoted.load_promoted when that module exists (which verifies the spec's own hash), else it reads the file's spec_hash field, else it hashes the file bytes (CRLF-normalised sha256).
_doc.spec_hash: The promoted spec's spec_hash at registration time. Condition 'spec_hash_unchanged' requires the spec loaded at gate time to carry exactly this value: a genome that was edited after registration is a different genome and its paper record does not count.
_doc.market_family: Series prefix the gate admits (weather = KXHIGH). Rows outside it are ignored, never counted.
_doc.grouping_unit: Independence unit. 'target_date': every settled trade on the same settlement day is one trial, because every bracket on a city-day ladder settles against the same CLI daily high. n counts units, not fills.
_doc.unit_win_rule: How a unit's outcome is decided: 'date_pnl_gt_0' = the unit's summed net PnL (closed_trades pnl minus entry_fee) is strictly positive. A unit with net PnL exactly 0 is a loss.
_doc.thresholds.n_min: Minimum number of settled units before the binomial test may run. Below it gate.py REFUSES (exit 3) rather than reporting an underpowered p.
_doc.thresholds.alpha: One-sided significance level. Condition 'p_lt_alpha' is p < alpha, strict.
_doc.thresholds.net_pnl_gt: Condition 'net_pnl_gt_0' is sum over settled units of (pnl - entry_fee) > this value (0.0). PnL is read from closed_trades / the journal, never from equity or balance (the UTC-midnight reset double-subtracts).
_doc.test: Exact binomial upper tail, no scipy: p = P[X >= k | n, q_bar] = sum_{i=k..n} C(n,i) q_bar^i (1-q_bar)^(n-i) with math.comb. k = winning units, n = settled units, q_bar = mean over units of the unit breakeven win-rate.
_doc.breakeven: Per fill bought at price p with entry fee f per contract and held to settlement (payout 1, no settlement fee): win pays 1 - p - f, loss pays -(p + f); q*(1-p-f) - (1-q*)(p+f) = 0 gives q* = p + f. A unit's breakeven is the contract-weighted mean of its fills' q*; the pooled null q_bar is the plain mean of unit breakevens. With one fill per unit this is exact; with several fills per unit the 'date_pnl_gt_0' event is not exactly Bernoulli(q*), which is why gate.py also prints the per-fill binomial as a secondary, non-gating line.
_doc.fee_type: Fee leg the sandbox books. 'taker': fills are booked with is_maker=False, so the entry fee is fee_calculator.taker_fee at actual quantity (ceil to the cent on the order total). The gate takes entry_fee from closed_trades when the row is present there and recomputes the taker fee from (entry_price, quantity) only for journal rows the state file no longer holds.
_doc.adverse_fill: The allowance the promoted strategy adds to the quote (limit_price = quote + adverse_fill). Recorded so the paper record can be re-read against the fill-realism study (scripts/measure_fill_realism.py); if that study raises adverse_fill the family must be re-scored and the registration re-issued, it is not edited in place.
_doc.contracts_frame: Order size the lab frame priced fees at (20). The sandbox's Kelly sizing differs (CONTRA 10); scripts/factory_paper_reconcile.py reports per-contract numbers at actual qty.
_doc.settled_only: Only rows closed by settlement count (close_reason EXPIRATION, exit_price in {0,1}, settlement_outcome recorded). SETTLEMENT_UNRESOLVED and every traded-out close are excluded and listed under 'excluded'.
_doc.registered_before_first_trade: Human-readable statement. The check is the git history: the commit adding gate_registration.json must predate the first journal row for strategy_name. If registration_commit_utc is filled in, gate.py additionally enforces min(entry_time) >= registration_commit_utc as condition 'registered_before_first_trade'; when it is null the condition is reported as UNVERIFIED and the operator must check the git log by hand.

registered_before_first_trade: This file must be committed before the first paper trade of strategy_name; verify with `git log --diff-filter=A -- configs/factory/gate_registration.json` against the first journal row.
